notes.title: Achievements Added to Steep
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Steam Achievements are now available for Steep! 
As a heads up, achievements will be retroactively earned for the accomplishments already completed in your game. For the sync to happen you need to launch the game once, and the previously unlocked Ubisoft Connect achievements will be automatically unlocked on Steam. 

To ensure that you can complete 100% of the Steam Achievements for Steep, we've removed 6 achievements that required DLC that is no longer available.

See you on the slopes!

notes.title: The 9 most extreme sports in games
notes.content:
One Off The List is our weekly list feature. Is there something you think doesn’t deserve to be on this list? Comment with your reasons why, and next week it may be struck off.

Football. Tennis. Conkers. What do these historic, reputable sports have in common, I ask you. That’s correct, they are not extreme enough. Please, quiet now. I am here to do the talking. Yes, there are sports videogames, your FIFAs and your Mario Tennises. But they do not fulfill the desire within all of us for the extreme, the radical, the pushing of it to the max. I will now demonstrate, through force of listicle, the 9 most extreme sports in PC games, from bone-breaking snowboarders to motorcycle Wipeout. And you, in your turn, shall be thankful to this website for providing such diversion. Now, read.

notes.title: Five of the Best: Snow
notes.content:
Holy macaroni it's the final Five of the Best of the year! This is our weekly series where we sprinkle some love on the overlooked parts of games. We've talked about potions, caves, hands, shops, hubs, maps, mountains and many more. There's a Five of the Best archive if you fancy a butcher's.

Snow! I wonder about snow. Hardly any falls where I live so whenever it does, everyone gets very excited for it. The ugly grey concrete we see every day is hidden under a fluffy white blanket, as if to say, "Don't worry about all that stuff, unless of course you walk into it, but go out and do something else instead. Be with friends! Be with family! The trains don't bloody work anyway." So the country grinds to a halt and we all rush outside to slide down hills on sledges, baking trays, dustbin lids, plastic bags - anything we can find. There's no thought for safety as people plummet down, careering into people walking up - I once saw someone perform a whole impromptu somersault - and we all return home at the end of the day with bruises and a spot of hypothermia. It's a great day out.

So when I see snow in a video game, the same butterflies of excitement flutter around inside me. But I wonder, is it the same for those of you who live where it snows a lot? You must see so much you are sick of the sight of it. Do you like snow in games or does it give you nightmares? Do let me know!

notes.title: Ubisoft's extreme winter sports romp Steep is currently free on PC
notes.content:
Fans of sports, the cold, and mostly going downward are in for a treat (as long as they own a PC); Ubisoft's enjoyable, open-world extreme winter sports extravaganza Steep is currently free to download and keep via Uplay.

Steep originally released on Xbox One, PlayStation 4, and PC in 2016, to what Wikipedia tells me was a "mixed to average" critical response. Clearly nobody asked Eurogamer's Christian Donlan or myself, because we both really quite enjoyed it.

Admittedly, my own positive feelings toward Steep have mostly been directed at the walls and ceiling until now, but Donlan awarded its sometimes uneven, but frequently exhilarating, blend of extreme sports and vast, freeing expanses, a Eurogamer Recommended back in the day.

We have recently updated the Live Seasons system to offer even [b]more rewards[/b]. Every season will now last for [b]1 month[/b] instead of 3. This way, we’ll be able to drastically improve the opportunities you will have to get new and interesting rewards!

[b]We are committed to support[/b] your passion for Steep as much as ever. We are grateful for the love you are constantly showing for the game. It means everything for us and we want you to keep having amazing adventures in the mountains. We are proud to [b]share this journey[/b] with all of you ❤️

We have also [b]improved[/b] each activity linked to the Seasons. Let’s take a look at what has changed.


[b]STEEP WORLD TOUR[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/4ac02a86baee14c5b1d860b423d6362837470470.jpg[/img]

The Steep World Tour will keep having 3 phases, but each one of them will now run [b]during weekends.[/b] In this way, it’ll be much simpler for you to take part and it’ll also help to achieve another important objective: making each phase more interesting.

We really want you to feel a competitive vibe when playing the tournament; right from the start. For this reason, we have [b]tweaked the difficulty[/b] of the qualifiers, to make them a bit more difficult. They were really too easy in the past.

We have also worked on evolving [b]the number of tries[/b] you will have in the 2nd and 3rd phases. The idea is to give you a reasonable amount of them to improve your score in the 2nd phase. A number you can aim to reach. It’s 200 now, down from 1000. You will also have more chances to realize your best performance during the Final with 20 tries now, up from 5.

We’ll keep iterating on the number of tries and on the difficulty of the challenges. Don’t hesitate to [b]share your feedback[/b] after having played the next Steep World Tour!


[b]UBISOFT CLUB WEEKLY CHALLENGES[/b]

We have introduced [b]new weekly challenges[/b] and updated quite a lot of the old ones. Every Tuesday you will find 7 challenges and they will let you obtain part of the exclusive monthly set. Some pieces are going to be obtainable [b]only during a specific week.[/b] Check in the game regularly to make sure you do not miss any reward!


[b]SEASON SPECIALS[/b]

These are special new challenges available for the full duration of each season (1 month), where you will be able to explore specific interesting areas of the game. Some of them will be very difficult while others more approachable. You will get Steep Credits by completing them.

Some of you will also get to make one of these challenges! Every month we’ll have a [b]Yeti Special[/b] realized by one of the Steep community leaders, members of our Yeti Society.



[b]SPECIAL EVENTS[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/ebe313f5c05fefcac563ba0a1ab229845ecced33.jpg[/img]

Every month we’ll have at least one special event [b]built around a specific theme[/b]. Sometimes it’ll be linked to a popular festivity, like [url=https://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-gb/competitor-basecamp/news/154-345569-16/]Saint Patrick's Day[/url] while in other moments it’ll be more surprising.

We don’t want to spoil the surprise already. We’ll regularly share more info about each event when they’ll go live, stay tuned on [url=https://www.instagram.com/steepgame_us/]our channels[/url] 👀

Have fun in taking part in those activities and [b]don’t forget to share[/b] your best Steep’s moments by using [b]#SteepPhotoMode[/b] or [b]#SteepGame[/b]!

notes.title: Walking on air – Tips for budding paragliders!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/b5280cc801b03c24306a1be2f2371a86a451ddc4.jpg[/img]

[u]#SteepPhotoMode by MrTronDaMon.[/u]

Hello Riders!

To close things off on our series of articles for Steep newcomers, we’re going to talk about paragliding!

Compared to the high-speed thrills of the wingsuit and rocket wingsuit, paragliding is a much more laid-back and relaxed air discipline. But that doesn’t mean it comes without its own challenges!

To help you get to grips with Steep’s paragliding mechanics and prepare you for its series of challenges, Yeti Society member [b]Mstifye[/b] has some tips to share with you!


[b]Tip #1: Facing your target[/b]

[i]“The less you have to turn the better! If your checkpoint is straight ahead, sometimes it’s the best to ease or take your thumb completely off of your left analog stick; this will make your paraglider glide straight towards the checkpoint if you were already on path. Any additional movement, dips or turns are unnecessary and could add lots of time to your score. So as long as you are trying to be as minimalistic as possible, you are sure to shave many seconds off of your time!”[/i]
hey

[b]Tip #2: For sharp turns[/b]

[i]“Make sure to Hold R2 (RT/”_”) as you are cutting around a tight corner to make a much sharper turn! This will make your movements as swift as possible, and will help you overcome the most intimidating paragliding obstacles throughout your challenge!”[/i]


[b]Tip #3: Glide in style![/b]

[i]“This is more of a fun one! If you hold R2 (RT/”_”) while in your paraglide and swing your left stick back and forth as if you were riding a swing, your character will eventually go farther and farther back until a full rotation is complete. This will be really fun to show off your flips to all of your friends riding along with you on the mountain!”[/i]


There you have it! We hope you enjoy your Steep paragliding experience. And while you’re up there, make sure to take in the view!


Oh, just one more thing:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/eb078a0532b3c14bba5146182ba4b1fd060b0666.jpg[/img]
[u]#SteepPhotoMode by GV_Kejypu.[/u]
In the last few weeks, we’ve noticed a lot of you have been taking to the slopes on your trusty sleds. We’d just like to give you guys a special shout-out!

Thank you very much for following this series of articles since the turn of the year; we’ll see you on the slopes!

The Steep Community Team

notes.title: Map Vote is now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/ede293faff9ed69fb1aad6809d0bc742b85b86bf.jpg[/img]

[u]#SteepPhotoMode by loIitea. Keep sharing your images![/u]

Since the release of the new PvP mode in Steep, you have often requested the introduction of a map vote feature. Today, we are adding it with [url=https://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1999576-Patch-notes-%E2%80%93-February-18th]a new update[/url].

Try it now!


[b]How does it work?[/b]

To join the PvP multiplayer lobby you need to go in the Mountain View. There you will see a banner at the top of the screen highlighting what you need to press to enter the automatic matchmaking system.

You will then group with up to three other players, then the competition will start and you will join a random match in progress. After having played that first random playlist, everyone in the group will be able to vote on what to play next. It is also possible that you will join during a map vote.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/7f241615ce9550cfd8115aff832f40e1019eeb5a.jpg[/img]

The first option will be to repeat the last playlist while the other two will let you try something different. The option with the higher amount of votes will win.


[b]All PvP playlists[/b] will be available with the introduction of the map vote and we will keep adding new playlists in the coming months. We will also keep having special PvP weekend events.


[b]Keep following[/b] us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/steepgame_us/?hl=en]Instagram[/url] and join the community on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Steep/]Reddit[/url] so you don't miss any future updates!

notes.title: Show off Your Tricks with Insane Drops!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/75fa7ebe78274682e85304b94587c88d2aebd7de.jpg[/img]


Hello Riders!

We highlighted the best entry-level spots for our beginners over the last few weeks, and it is time to take it up a notch! The Yeti Society is back with recommendations for our most daring players. Hit the slopes and try out these exhilarating jumps for yourself!


Our first recommendation comes from Yeti member [b]SteepSteep[/b], who encourages the bravest of the brave to try out this massive jump in the Alps. [b][Coordinates: ALPS 6351 S - 7160 W][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/b25482f46a7189015c9e1e56efb7de7e9b29b647.jpg[/img]

SteepSteep offers the following advice [u]“If you guys want to session the biggest jump in the game, follow these coordinates in the Alps and you will be right at it. This massive jump is nestled between a lot of cliffs making it difficult to find. Its monstrosity and small landing make for an extremely high margin for error which makes this jump very difficult to land. Challenge yourself to throw the steeziest trick off this massive feature or see how many flips/spins you can pull off its insanity.”[/u] Watch his video [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0IWMVJJw5K4]here[/url] for a full play by play!


Our second jump spot was handpicked by [b]vi77ain[/b], for any adventurous snowboarders exploring the Japan. [b][Coordinates 7300 N – 450 W][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/4f2f44ea9ad3af347f980c1511d239b75a47af2a.jpg[/img]

[u]“It is the biggest jump in the game, by far. Longest air time, you can get the most flips out of here. Actually this is the video of me doing 13 backflips off of it, which as far as I’ve seen, nobody else has done yet!”[/u]

Do you think you can top vi77ain’s 13 backflip record? Check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yzaA4EOrCxQ&feature=youtu.be]this video[/url] for the incredible gameplay clip and the full list of vi77ain’s top 10 jump spots.


Share your best video clips or #SteepPhotoMode screenshots from your runs by using the hashtag #SteepGame or tagging us on [url=https://twitter.com/steep_game?lang=en]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/steepgame_us/?hl=en]Instagram[/url].

See you next week with more recommendations from the Yeti Society! The Steep Community Team

notes.title: Become a Wingsuit proximity master
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/0298dc7b2342576d74c8bd0391d8ce1facd97e27.jpg[/img]

If you’ve been following our recent Steep challenge articles, you will have already gotten to grips with [url=http://steepgame.com/trickchallenges]tricks[/url] and races with your [url=http://steepgame.com/racechallenges]snowboard or skis[/url] thanks to a series of entry-level challenges recommended by our dedicated Steep players in the Yeti Society

This week, [b]we take to the skies![/b]

This article is all about Wingsuit proximity challenges. Unlike the time-sensitive races, these require you to pass through checkpoints while staying as close to the ground and passing as closely by obstacles as possible. Be sure to send us some [b]#SteepPhotoMode[/b] images of your proximity runs on social media!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/f46c7834f873db4a88271cfb259bf48e6a5a1c16.jpg[/img]

One of our British Yetis, [b]Calplex[/b], has a couple of recommendations. The first is [b]Say Hi![/b] in the Alps.

[i]“Unlike the time challenges, it is all about taking risk to get that gold. If you’re feeling brave and up for the challenge you can throw yourself very close to the glaciers and rocks. If you wanted to take it easy and get used to the wingsuit mechanics you can glide beside the sharp rocks and not have to worry about dodging or getting your risk factor high. You can take your own time with the challenge, when you are ready you can take the challenge on and up your personal best!”[/i]

Say Hi! is located at [b]1738 N – 5360 W[/b] in [b]Aiguilles.[/b]

But that is not all! Calplex continues:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/fc5d304a21d75e3a2623ab69c9cbf21e4739005c.jpg[/img]

[i]“If you are looking for the same sort of challenge but in Alaska. I would recommend [b]Fly like a Whale[/b]; it’s the exact same sort of challenge which you can take at your own pace.”[/i]

You will find that Alaska challenge at the coordinates [b]1437 S – 1527 W[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/39435eb95a4b11963db6e597954f19eba883887f.jpg[/img]

Steep wingsuit expert [b]Bonecrusher2D[/b] also has an Alaska challenge if you feel up to it. [b]Kahiltna Fly[/b] begins at [b]1468 N – 2749 W[/b], and you shouldn’t let the difficulty rating discourage you:

[i]“The canyons and rocks add a depth of play meaning you can be safe and take the outside, or you can try flying through these small caverns.”[/i]

For each of these challenges, you’ll notice the same piece of advice: play it safe during your first attempts, then gradually challenge yourself to get closer and closer to the ground.


[b]Want to see how the pros do it?[/b]

Why not check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkG8SLtfu5dcyYPRbsmBuIA]Team AVALANCHE’s YouTube channel[/url], featuring world record runs of the above challenges from members of our Yeti Society such as [b]Bonecrusher2D[/b] and [b]SiNoMaTiC![/b]

If you’re looking for help on any challenges in Steep, or if you’d like to share your success stories, check out our official [url=https://forums.ubi.com/forumdisplay.php/1251-Steep]forums[/url] or [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Steep/]Reddit[/url] .

The Steep Team

notes.title: Tournament Leaderboard Refresh Rate
notes.content:
[IMG]https://i.imgur.com/dSujOF7.png[/IMG]
[I]#SteepPhotoMode by TorriderMuffin via Reddit[/I]

Last weekend we had a degradation of our online services linked to Steep, this is why some of you have experienced difficulties in connecting to the game. We are sorry about that. 

The issue was caused by the refresh rate of the Steep World Tour leaderboard. A lot of you is taking part in the competition and this created the degradation. To quickly resolve the problem we have applied a delay in the tournament leaderboard refresh rate. Your score is still immediately tracked by our servers when you complete one of your tries. The only difference is that the tournament leaderboard is now updated around every 1h and 30 minutes. In some circumstances it can require more time. 

Don’t worry if you don’t immediately see your score in the live page of the tournament. Even if it’s not visible in that page, it’s still tracked and it’ll eventually appear. 

We understand it’s an inconvenience, but in this way we can guarantee a better experience to all players, preventing any major degradation related to this issue.

Thanks for your patience, we’ll keep working to identify a better solution.

The Steep Team

notes.title: The best Wingsuit spots for Steep beginners!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/4c8f678eeb4b20251d637e227b90cfdd039b9e2d.jpg[/img]

Hello Riders!

Steep has a number of different sports for you to master. A couple of weeks ago we highlighted some of our most devoted players’ favourite spots for beginner-level skiers and snowboarders to execute some huge jumps. This week, the Yeti Society is back with some recommended locations for honing your wingsuit skills!


Our first Yeti is [b]Bonecrusher2D[/b], who believes the ideal location across Steep’s two mountain ranges is the Matterhorn, a region in the Alps. The entire region’s layout is full of great spots, making it an ideal fit for spectacular wingsuit runs!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/569eebdb6a447b1086e5a561f36d67d8807db33f.jpg[/img]

Bonecrusher2D had this to say: [i]“Explore the Matterhorn in death defying wing suit runs. If you are looking for a challenge in the wing suit you won't find a better mountain suited to your tastes. See if you can find all 23 needle point rock holes to fly through and prove you have what it takes to fly a wing suit.”[/i]


There are certainly areas beyond the Matterhorn where you can train to become a wingsuit master! And we have a specific example in the Alps here from [b]Vekst[/b], a moderator on the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Steep/]Steep sub-reddit[/url]:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/2252b7465bcf7ad70b9687b92ecdd45d910cac77.jpg[/img]

[i]“A drop zone that I enjoy practicing on is Aiguille Du Gouter. It's a small peak of Mont Blanc that has some small surprises in store for new riders. There's a decent amount of trees and small rocks that you need to look out for while gliding down the slopes, as they can end your run extremely quick if you don't pay attention.[/i]

[i]There's a specific spot there that I like to use with the coords of 1889 N - 244 W. If you try to take on this small peak, don't be afraid of getting close to the mountain, getting close is how you get the big points. With my coords, just go down and follow the natural path that the mountain gives, it will help you out a lot with hard challenges where you need to be extremely close to the mountain to win.”[/i]


Some fine recommendations from our Yeti Society - we think these suggestions will show off the exhilarating nature of the wingsuit. And if you attempt to master these locations, we’d love to see some video clips of your runs! Share them with us using the hashtag #SteepGame, or send your best #SteepPhotoMode screenshots!

See you next week!

The Steep Community Team

notes.title: Best Challenges to Improve Your Tricks!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/e3e87e70880f98b5444cf8b646f60dec712923ae.jpg[/img]


Are you new to Steep or would you like to improve your highest scores? Practice makes perfect!

One of our most experienced players, Mstifye, has personally selected a few challenges that can bring you up to expert level in no time. You can find these challenges by exploring Steep’s open world and discovering new Drop Zones.


[b]Learning the ropes[/b]

[b]Mstifye[/b] recommends trying the Bargy Snowpark challenge in the Alps for ski / snowboard fans. You’ll find it in the [b]Ponte Percée[/b] region.

Coordinates: 4813 S - 345 E

[u]“This is the challenge where I perfected my jumps and understood how the jump system in STEEP worked. I understood how to prepare for jumps and how to execute them.”[/u]

Most of the challenges with blue guidelines are a good starting point for practicing your ski and snowboarding skills. During a challenge, hold "_" to crouch and prepare for a jump, then release it near the top of the jump to reach maximum height. The blue guidelines on ramps in challenges like Bargy and Jumps clearly mark the best spot to pop your tricks- a perfect way to practice!


[b]Upping the ante[/b]

After you feel comfortable with the guidelines, it’s time to practice what you’ve learned on some more advanced challenges without guidance or restrictions. [b]Glacier Hurdles[/b] in Aiguille Verte is a fan-favorite Freerider challenge in the Alps, featuring a long track with smooth transfers, creative lines, and massive jumps. Mstifye also recommends the [b]Space Jump[/b] in the Matterhorn for courageous players who crave more airtime. [u]“This is one of the biggest drops in the game, this challenge will give you plenty of time in the air to practice spins and your most impressive flips. Landing it is a different story though.”[/u]


Grab your skis and snowboards and try out these challenges for yourself! While you’re at it, why not share your clips using the hashtag #SteepGame, or send us your best #SteepPhotoMode images?

If you would like more advice and tips from the Steep community experts, stop by our [url=http://steepgame.com/feedback]official forums[/url] or [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Steep/]Reddit[/url].

notes.title: New to Steep? Here are some great locations for big jumps!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/e9e13b9fc2a10edda62e20f123d02bdfaebbc451.jpg[/img]

Hello Riders!

If you’re new to the game, allow us to welcome you to this awesome community! We’re sure it won’t take long for you to feel right at home.

Steep is a big game – there is plenty to see and do, and the game has only grown since it first released in 2016. We can appreciate that it may be tough for newcomers to decide where to start. One of your first decisions will be the sport: skis, snowboard, wingsuit or paraglider?

On top of that, you’ll be wondering where you can go and what you can do across the two regions available in the base game: the Alps and Alaska. Decisions, decisions…

We would like to help you with that. So every second Tuesday for the next two months, we and our friends in the community will give you some pointers on what to do when you first hop into the wintery world of Steep.

For this first article, we have asked members of our Yeti Society – some of our most devoted community members – to highlight and pinpoint three of the best spots for new riders to execute some BIG jumps. You can use the coordinates provided to find the location in the mountain view.

For newcomers, the easiest way to reach a location will be by rocket wingsuit, but when you reach level 25, you will have an infinite supply of helicopter tickets to fast-travel anywhere you want!

The first location is in the Alps, recommended by [b]vi77ain[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/02b4511bf353f783480411357ecdd3fc0e44925e.jpg[/img]

Coordinates: 2780N - 3800E

Vi77ain had this to say: “[u]Furi is a small church village in the Aoste region, but it holds big secrets. It has one of the only church spires you can jump through but it won't let you do it so easily. Also nearby are side hits, buildings, logs and tractors to play around with. There is even a bust of the Mother Mary who watches and protects this village. I spent an entire day here filming a video, good fun for those who can uncover its charms.[/u]”


This next recommendation, located in Alaska, comes courtesy of [b]Mstifye[/b].

Coordinates: 2991N - 3796E

So why did Mstifye go for this spot? Because it’s “[u]a huge Alaskan Jump, but from the comfort of a ramp to launch you off precisely. The ramp also helps control which direction you want to land much easier than a cliff jump! Some might remember this jump from the ending of the challenge ‘Silverfall II’. Since then, this has remained one of the most exhilarating jumps that I find myself running back to over and over again! Not the biggest jump in Steep, but don't let it fool you, it'll knock your snow boots off![/u]”


Our third recommendation is a real toughie to pull off, but luckily we have a demonstration from [b]steeppeeps[/b] on Instagram to prove that it is possible!

[url=https://www.instagram.com/p/Bq_JobMgSVm/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/6134b515a4cdf97fea4d9ab51f1a63c085ca4594.jpg[/img][/url]
 
Coordinates: 3922S - 5974W

“[u]Here is a STYLED Misty 5 safety through an abandoned complex in the Alps.[/u]” Steeppeeps does admit: “[u]This spot is very difficult to land a trick, but that's what makes it incredibly fun. Send in your clips of the tricks you get through this complex![/u]”

We would certainly love to see more of you guys pulling off this impressive stunt! So please share your footage with us using the hashtag [b]#SteepGame[/b]! Or why not send us your best screenshots in [b]#SteepPhotoMode[/b]?


Next week, we and the Yeti Society will discuss our favourite challenges for newcomers. We’ll see you there!

The Steep Community Team

notes.title: How to get more XP – PvP Beta update – December 13th

In [URL=https://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1970552]Monday's title update[/URL], we increased the global amount of XP you get while playing the PvP mode. Now we are going to take a look at how many points you can actually get and under what circumstances.

It’s worth noting that the amount of your DNF (Did Not Finish) runs have a big impact on the experience points you get. Even just by limiting your DNFs, you can increase your rewards by a big margin; completing all challenges is a very good way to earn more rewards.

[B]Finishing a run – completing a single challenge of any playlist[/B]

[*]3rd – 11,000 xp

[*]3rd – 10,500 xp
[*]4th – 9,000 xp[/LIST]

notes.title: Introducing New PvP Multiplayer Mode for Steep
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/fd5b535d2a7795e4eea5d42d8b29ac8c69044b3b.jpg[/img]

Challenge your friends in the new Steep PvP multiplayer mode - available for free to all players as part of the next update, rolling out on October 29th for PC players and coming soon for PS4 and Xbox One Players. The first phase of implementing this new mode will be a beta state, so we can test the technical infrastructure and continue to iterate. Try it first and [url=http://steepgame.com/feedback]share your feedback[/url]!

“Steep is a multiplayer game at its core – you can always seamlessly play with other players. But so far, the moments when you play together with the same objective are rare,” Steep Creative Director Igor Manceau commented. “We’ve been working to find the right combination of cooperative and competitive play, where players can truly play together, at the same moment, and tackle the same dedicated objectives together.”


[h1]How does it work?[/h1]

Start by joining the multiplayer lobby in the Mountain View and our automatic matchmaking system will group you with up three other players. As soon as everyone is ready, a 5-second timer will appear and count down to the start of the match. When the countdown reaches zero, the competition begins.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/379755e6f1dd8a77894e5b240f8d62c899608943.jpg[/img]

You will encounter a series of different challenges in the Alps, linked together through playlists. Every PvP session will start with a randomized playlist. Each playlist includes different challenges with the same theme, such as race, freestyle, rocket wingsuit, and wingsuit. You will compete twice in every challenge before the final winner is decided. The synchronous PvP gameplay also allows for collisions with other players, so pay close attention to your surroundings!

Steep Game Director Arnaud Ragot said, “We knew from the start that synchronous multiplayer would be a very cool experience, but many things surprised us during development. During our play sessions, we found that this new mode brings out a lot of different types of emotions! You can have a lot of fun colliding together, and there may even be some drama when you find yourself losing to your friend at the last 10 meters.

We also found that character customization immediately become more exciting with synchronous multiplayer. We started to spend more time at the beginning of each play session to create our own unique style, to personalize our outfit in fun ways, and stand out in a crowd – adding some additional flavor to the overall Steep experience. We can’t wait to get this in your hands, and for you to have as much fun as we are with this new way to enjoy the game.”

We’ll regularly update you on our forums and social media on the progress of this beta phase.

See you on the slopes!

notes.title: PC Hotfix - September 3rd | Crash at launch
notes.content:
After having received some reports about the game crashing when launched on PC, we have investigated and we can now confirm that some Intel Graphics Driver for Windows (e.g. version 23.20.16.4973) might introduce this problem. The issue is evident if Intel’s onboard graphics card is disabled in the Device Manager.

If this is your setup, please manually update your driver to the latest version, from Intel’s [URL=https://downloadcenter.intel.com/product/80939/Graphics-Drivers]website[/URL]. We have also released an hotfix today to help further, while we keep monitoring the situation. notes.title: Steep is getting challenge event seasons with unique rewards, starting next month
notes.content:
Ubisoft's enormously enjoyable open-world winter sports game Steep will be getting special challenge event seasons, with their own exclusive rewards, starting next month.

The new system, known as Live Activities Seasons, tasks players with besting a variety of temporary challenges in order to win an exclusive set of gear. Different challenges award different parts of the unique gear, with a new gear set and new challenges being introduced every three months.

Season 1 of Ubisoft's new initiative begins on April 1st and runs until June 29th, with a second and third season planned for July to September and October to December respectively.

Read more…

notes.title: Winter Update - What is new in Steep?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/b8764c0a5a442d5d9c8b13bdaaa1edaa34e1963a.jpg[/img]

Dear STEEP Riders,

Please find below the highlights of the new patch we will deploy on all platforms on [b]March 27th[/b].


[h1]Infinite progression and bonus XP[/h1]
We have removed the level 30 cap restriction. From then, you will be able to progress infinitely and get rewarded with Steep Credits every time you will reach a new level.

To support you, we have planned a series of [b]temporary Bonus XP events[/b] – we will communicate on due time - so stay tuned: more info coming soon :)


[h1]Ranked mode[/h1]
To make sure our Freestyle challenges leaderboards only feature true champions – we have added a ranked mode to our game.

From March 27th, we will reset all Freestyle challenges leaderboards and only players with ranked mode “ON” will be able to access those.

By playing ranked, you will have to score with a restricted amount of tricks at your disposal (specific to each challenge) - but that is what it takes to become a true champion right? :)


[h1]Live Activities[/h1]
From April 1st, we will launch the first season of our live activities season system! Every 3 months, you will have the opportunity to win an EPIC and EXCLUSIVE EQUIPMENT SET by taking on various temporary challenges. [url=https://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-gb/competitor-basecamp/news/154-320178-16/introducing-live-activities-seasons]More info here[/url].

Any question? Please let us know [url=https://forums.ubi.com/forumdisplay.php/1251]on the forums[/url].

Dear STEEP Riders,

Please find below the highlights of the new patch we will deploy on all platforms on [b]March 27th[/b].


[h1]Infinite progression and bonus XP[/h1]
We have removed the level 30 cap restriction. From then, you will be able to progress infinitely and get rewarded with Steep Credits every time you will reach a new level.

To support you, we have planned a series of [b]temporary Bonus XP events[/b] – we will communicate on due time - so stay tuned: more info coming soon :)


[h1]Ranked mode[/h1]
To make sure our Freestyle challenges leaderboards only feature true champions – we have added a ranked mode to our game.

From March 27th, we will reset all Freestyle challenges leaderboards and only players with ranked mode “ON” will be able to access those.

By playing ranked, you will have to score with a restricted amount of tricks at your disposal (specific to each challenge) - but that is what it takes to become a true champion right? :)


[h1]Live Activities[/h1]
From April 1st, we will launch the first season of our live activities season system! Every 3 months, you will have the opportunity to win an EPIC and EXCLUSIVE EQUIPMENT SET by taking on various temporary challenges. [url=https://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-gb/competitor-basecamp/news/154-320178-16/introducing-live-activities-seasons]More info here[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes - December 15th
notes.content:
Dear Steep Riders,

Please find below the list of fixed issues following the implementation of our new patch (TU15) this morning.

[h1]PS4[/h1]
Korean language wasn’t supported by the game on European consoles. The Korean language is now available.

[h1]PC[/h1]
Due to the usage of an EnhancedInstructionSet that is not compatible with i5 1st gen and old AMD, some PC players couldn’t play Steep since December 4th. This is now fixed and PC players can again play Steep.

[h1]ALL[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]One flag was misplaced in the Downhill event causing scoring issues. This flag was put back to the right place.
[*]We fixed several issues on the journey walkthrough.
[*]Only 14 languages were supported for subtitles on European consoles so far.
[*]Watching Replays, we’ve identified some players were able to score extra points riding in slow motion. We fixed that exploit.
[*]We fixed several grind bugs in Alaska
[*]We fixed some crash issues.
[/LIST]

Please keep sending your feedback!

Thanks,
The STEEP Team

notes.title: Patch notes - December 4th
notes.content:
Hello Steep Riders!

[B]On December 4th[/B] we are going to publish a new patch for Steep, accessible to all players. Below you can find the detailed patch notes.

[h1]Grind improvements[/h1]
[LIST][*]New controls
[LIST]
[*]Rotation is now on Left Stick with directions left/right controlled by Right Stick while using a controller. With a keyboard the rotation is by default on W, A, S, D with directions left/right controlled by J/L.
[/LIST]

[*]More Tricks (Nose – Tail – Rotation)
[LIST][*]It’s now possible to do a lot more tricks while grinding, full list down below. Previously, you were only able to do rotations.
[LIST]
[*]Rotations with Left Stick left/right (A/D with a keyboard by default).
[*]Nose press with Left Stick up (W with a keyboard by default).
[*]Tail press with Left Stick down (S with a keyboard by default).
[*]You can combine rotations with Nose/Tail press.
[*]Lateral navigation with Right Stick left/right (J/L with a keyboard by default).
[*]Transfer with Right Stick + Jump (I, J, K, L + Space with a keyboard by default).
[/LIST][/LIST]

[*]It’s now easier to enter and exit rails.
[*]We have added grind scoring and a specific camera.[/LIST]

[h1]Big Air and Half Pipe improvements[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]You can now jump higher in these two events. Landings have also been optimized and we have added a specific camera.
[/LIST]
 
[h1]All icons have been reworked[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]We have reworked all icons in Mountain View/Menu, now it should be clearer to understand what each activity is about.
[/LIST]

[h1]The Store and Character pages have been updated[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]Both pages have a brand new layout, it’s now easier to navigate through them. 
[/LIST]

[h1]Some challenges in Alps and Alaska have been updated [/h1]
[LIST]
[*]We have updated around 30 challenges in Alps and Alaska, optimizing their field of expertise, name, difficulty or rules. In particular, we’ll also reset the leaderboards of all challenges with an updated set of rules (list down below).
[LIST]
[*]Alps
[LIST]
[*]NIGHT OWL
[*]TREESTYLER
[*]GOOD VIBES
[*]VERTIGO
[*]ICY LICKING
[*]WINTER FORESTS
[/LIST]
[*]Alaska
[LIST]
[*]CREST MANIAC
[*]RUTH CREST
[*]STREET STYLER
[/LIST]
[/LIST][/LIST]

[h1]A new way to get Sled, Rocket wingsuit, Speed Riding, Base jump[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]It’s now possible to buy every single sport added in a previous DLC (Sled, Rocket wingsuit, Speed Riding, Base jump) with Steep Credits. 
[/LIST]

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]The Korean language is now supported.
[*]Minor bugs and technical issues have been fixed across all platforms.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Steep World Tour Stars: isebba420
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/9bf708a73d4e767158910ed21bae3c5888d8e74b.jpg[/img]

The fourth series of the Steep World Tour Season 2, [b]Natural freestyle[/b], ended a few days ago. Now it's the time to properly celebrate [b]isebba420[/b], the player who was able to get the best score across all platform. Let's discover more about him and how he managed to achieve this important result.

[h1]Where does your name come from?[/h1]
Ever since I was a little kid, people always called me "sebba" (short for my real name), so I figured why not use it for my gamertag as well.

[h1]How long have you been playing Steep?[/h1]
I don’t remember the date when I first started playing Steep, but I know I have been grinding all platforms for a combined time of over 2000 hours!

[h1]What’s your favorite Challenge in Steep?[/h1]
My favorite challenge is Butterfly (Paragliding). It’s really easy making the competitive side of this challenge really fun! New time saves have been found again and again, for months, and the world record has had many holders. A few weeks ago me and super-pilot, another passionate Steep's player, decided to have a battle for the world record, ending up with me almost maxing out the time limit for the challenge. If you decide to attempt that world record, expect to put many hours into it; competitive paragliding can be very tricky to learn.

[h1]In what state of mind did you join this competition?[/h1]
My state of mind was to stay calm and get a safe win.

[h1]When did you first start believing in your chances to win this competition?[/h1]
I knew I had a high chance at winning during the last day of the finals, because most of the best players had already taken their attempts and they where not happy with the scores they got.

[h1]Could you tell us a bit more about your competitive style and strategy?[/h1]
For most levels, I have already spent time working out a run that works best for me. If it’s too extreme to do in only 3 attempts, I switch up the run and make it safe enough to get a high score and not crash at the same time.

[h1]Any tips for rookies?[/h1]
For me, the most important thing is to make my own runs and not just copy the 1st all time run. Try always to do the run that you feel most comfortable with. This is very important for semi finals / finals, since you have limited attempts you don't want to go too extreme and maybe lose that 4X multiplier. Another important thing I do before I start, is to warm up with other challenges. I find this very helpful :)

Congratulations again to isebba420 for this great performance in the Steep World Tour!

I don’t remember the date when I first started playing Steep, but I know I have been grinding all platforms for a combined time of over 2000 hours!

[h1]What’s your favorite Challenge in Steep?[/h1]
My favorite challenge is Butterfly (Paragliding). It’s really easy making the competitive side of this challenge really fun! New time saves have been found again and again, for months, and the world record has had many holders. A few weeks ago me and super-pilot, another passionate Steep's player, decided to have a battle for the world record, ending up with me almost maxing out the time limit for the challenge. If you decide to attempt that world record, expect to put many hours into it; competitive paragliding can be very tricky to learn.

[h1]In what state of mind did you join this competition?[/h1]
My state of mind was to stay calm and get a safe win.

[h1]When did you first start believing in your chances to win this competition?[/h1]
I knew I had a high chance at winning during the last day of the finals, because most of the best players had already taken their attempts and they where not happy with the scores they got.

[h1]Could you tell us a bit more about your competitive style and strategy?[/h1]
For most levels, I have already spent time working out a run that works best for me. If it’s too extreme to do in only 3 attempts, I switch up the run and make it safe enough to get a high score and not crash at the same time.

[h1]Any tips for rookies?[/h1]
For me, the most important thing is to make my own runs and not just copy the 1st all time run. Try always to do the run that you feel most comfortable with. This is very important for semi finals / finals, since you have limited attempts you don't want to go too extreme and maybe lose that 4X multiplier. Another important thing I do before I start, is to warm up with other challenges. I find this very helpful :)

Congratulations again to isebba420 for this great performance in the Steep World Tour!

notes.title: Steep World Tour Stars: ItsMstifye
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/59fa0e1c3cba2231daf692e92e0836b08201443c.png[/img]

The [b]Freeride World Tour[/b], the third series of the Steep World Tour Season 2, ended a few days ago. We have interviewed [b]ItsMstifye[/b], the player who was able to get the best score across all platform. Let's discover more about him and how he managed to achieve this important result.

[h1]Where does your name come from?[/h1]
I decided on the username ItsMstifye because Mstifye was already taken. I really like using the username on Steep though, because players can see me riding down a mountain and say "Its Mstifye!". So I guess it works fantastic in the open world of Steep.

[h1]How long have you been playing Steep?[/h1]
The first time I played Steep was during the closed Alpha. When I first heard that you could sign up for the alpha, I rushed and filled it out hoping I would get in. It's insane that the closed alpha was over a whole year ago. Time really flew by!

[h1]What’s your favorite Challenge in Steep?[/h1]
I've really been enjoying playing Red Bull Ultra Natural recently. The ramps are very relaxing to go off of. The challenge has tons of different paths to go down and it's really turned into my chill challenge I turn to when I need something to play.

[h1]In what state of mind did you join this competition?[/h1]
My state of mind when I joined the competition was to win, but also to have fun. Friendly competition is always great, it keeps the game fresh and the fun alive for me.

[h1]When did you first start believing in your chances to win this competition?[/h1]
I started to believe in my chances of winning when I was practicing the map Steep Aravis a few days before the finals with my friend Calplex. I ended up trying a new method and I got the world record! That's when I knew I had a pretty good shot at winning. About a few hours after the finals had started, Isebba told me that he, unfortunately, messed up his turns. After that, I was fairly confident in my chances of winning.

[h1]Could you tell us a bit more about your competitive style and strategy?[/h1]
My strategy is trying to make the most out of every run. I always try to use only 1 try at the start of the competition and save the rest for later. In your runs make sure not to fall because you really don't want to lose your multiplier. If you do happen to fall get back up and keep going! Saving at least 1 of your tries as a safe run is a very smart move. In your safe run try to go a route that is less dangerous, try to find a way with high points and little risk. If you save a run or two to the very end of the finals, you'll have one more chance to put it all on the line and play very risky to win.

[h1]Any tips for rookies?[/h1]
First of all, make sure you always watch the first of all time replay before playing any challenge. If you're going the correct way to get the most points you already have a huge advantage. When you want a better chance of winning the Steep World Tour Finals make sure you keep an eye on Steep's website, they'll always put the final challenge name on there so you can start practicing right away. After you have an idea on the route you need to take by watching the replay, try to get very consistent. Try starting small, going through the map without falling and not worrying about points is a great place to start. After you master that you can break down your run and analyze where you can pick up few additional points along the way. If you keep increasing your personal best little by little eventually there will be a huge point increase overall! Practice really does make perfect. Learning your map surroundings and learning the G-force system takes time, but eventually you'll get the hang of it, just don't give up!

Congratulations to ItsMstifye for this important win and don't forget to join the [url=https://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-gb/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:154-303676-16&ct=tcm:154-76770-32]next series of the Steep World Tour[/url], started on October 13th.

notes.title: Steep World Tour Stars: super-pilot
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/88448ff2359ce0d9a98ba179bc2c506806536e4b.jpg[/img]

The second series of the Steep World Tour Season 2 about paragliding ended few days ago and we have interviewed [b]super-pilot[/b], the french player who was able to get the best time across all platform.

[h1]Where does your name come from?[/h1]
I’ve always been passionate about aeronautics and I chose this nickname a long, long time ago. I’ve kept it ever since.

[h1]How long have you been playing Steep?[/h1]
I’ve started to play during the beta and I'm still enjoying it.

[h1]What’s your favorite Challenge in Steep?[/h1]
It’s tough to choose one in particular between all the sports but "Steep Skills", in Alaska, is a slalom that I really love.

[h1]In what state of mind did you join this competition?[/h1]
Above all else I wanted to have fun with my friend zépequenot65, but I also wanted to win the competition. Whilst trying to be the fastest across all platforms, we trained together on those challenges and helped each other out. There were lots of great moments but also lots of fails! Despite our good times, we could never get complacent because the difficulty of those climbs meant our sails ended up in the rocks a lot ;)

[h1]When did you first start believing in your chances to win this competition?[/h1]
Once I succeeded in climbing quickly and without wiping out regularly, I told myself I could do well in a competition. The race course is very technical and the urge to try too hard can quickly catch you out and a wipe out usually follows.

[h1]Could you tell us a bit more about your competitive style and strategy?[/h1]
My strategy was to play at the last possible moment in the finals, I didn't want to give a reference time to other players. Always try to attack.

[h1]Any tips for rookies?[/h1]
It's important to not get frustrated if you don’t succeed. Come back and try again a bit later when you are more relaxed.

We want to congratulate again with super-pilot for this great achievement, well done! Don't forget to join the next series of the Steep World Tour on September 15th. [b]You can be the next champion![/b]

notes.title: Steep World Tour Stars #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/a93605e26c0829836a999e422224c77933e0cf28.jpg[/img]

STEEP WORLD TOUR SEASON 2-SERIES 1 just ended. Here you can find a few words from the PC Rider who won it.

[b]Where does your name come from?[/b]

I was really into editing years ago and wanted the name Cinematic. My username before that was SiN, I combined them both into SiNoMaTiC. Not very interesting I know. :)

[b]How long have you been playing STEEP?[/b]

8 months since the game was released. I played the Alpha and Beta religiously.

[b]What’s your favorite Challenge in STEEP?[/b]

My Favorite challenge would definitely be Jolly Jumper, I really like the style of the run and its surroundings.

[b]In what state of mind did you join this competition?[/b]

I honestly thought I was going to lose to my teammate Mstifye. We both have been practicing this map everyday for a week, and each of us beat the world record for the fastest time, it was anybody's race at that point.

[b]When did you first start believing in your chances to win this competition?[/b]

I started practicing a few hours before the final started and began getting 3:20 - 3:24 every try without fail. I broke the record again and got 3:19 and I felt pretty confident I was going to do well with my 2 tries.

[b]Could you tell us a bit more about your competitive style and strategy?[/b]

My Competitive style is do whatever you can to win, I'm real competitive with my friends on Steep who force me to push harder for those fast times. My strategy for this map was to get a feel for the fastest way watching first place, and seeing what I could improve to beat the time, figuring out a perfect line through the trees near the end really helped me secure a faster time, and the previous first place of all time for that map didn't quite go the fastest route to the end. :)

[b]Any tips for rookies?[/b]

Play the Moon challenge and learn to gain speed from the trees. :)

I honestly thought I was going to lose to my teammate Mstifye. We both have been practicing this map everyday for a week, and each of us beat the world record for the fastest time, it was anybody's race at that point.

[b]When did you first start believing in your chances to win this competition?[/b]

I started practicing a few hours before the final started and began getting 3:20 - 3:24 every try without fail. I broke the record again and got 3:19 and I felt pretty confident I was going to do well with my 2 tries.

[b]Could you tell us a bit more about your competitive style and strategy?[/b]

My Competitive style is do whatever you can to win, I'm real competitive with my friends on Steep who force me to push harder for those fast times. My strategy for this map was to get a feel for the fastest way watching first place, and seeing what I could improve to beat the time, figuring out a perfect line through the trees near the end really helped me secure a faster time, and the previous first place of all time for that map didn't quite go the fastest route to the end. :)

[b]Any tips for rookies?[/b]

Play the Moon challenge and learn to gain speed from the trees. :)

notes.title: Steep expansion carves path to 2018 Winter Olympics
notes.content:
Imagine a world in which Steep [official site] was a game about brewing tea. Instead of racing down snowy peaks you’d be keeping an anxious watch over a set of mugs, trying to gauge the strength of a brew and serving it to a visitor’s specifications. Harder levels would feature darker mugs making it hard to tell whether you’d got a tincture on your hands or something so full of tannins your cheeks would pucker at the bitterness.

What a world that would be. In THIS reality, however, Steep is about snowsports which means a Winter Olympics-themed event was an obvious candidate for an expansion. Swaddle up for the announcement trailer: … [visit site to read more]

Today, we’re very proud to introduce you to Steep’s [b]Yeti Society[/b]! The Yeti Society is (for now) a small “Club” of players who showed dedication to our game and are eager to push it beyond limits.

As you already know, Steep is here to stay and, since the very start, we want it to be [b]Community driven[/b]. This group is meant to help us moving forward with that and stay synced with your needs and expectations in the long run.

notes.title: Steep Star #9: Mstifye
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/08b79bfd370e0fa059163b3c14e8bfecca7eb7b4.jpg[/img]

[b]What name do you go by?[/b]

I like to go by Mstifye! I would love to say that there is a super interesting reason for that name, but no, it's just a word I found catchy and it rolled off the tongue when I created my Xbox Account back in 2012.

[b]What’s your primary Playstyle?[/b]

My primary Playstyle has to be Pro Rider. I love to put myself to the test! Ever since I started competitive gaming I've been obsessed with finding the best tricks/routes to achieve the highest possible score and also to push myself to raise my score as much as I can! This is what I find fun. When I am not doing that I am usually chilling by starting at the top of a mountain and riding all the way down to discover what obstacles are in my way.

[b]Your favorite sport to play in Steep?[/b]

All of them are great and have a unique purpose, but I feel like I would be crazy not to say Snowboard since it is the majority of my gameplay! I also love wingsuit a lot.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/edc591c3f38442b8d7d1ddff9ac3a38a17f0f329.jpg[/img]

[b]Favorite spot?[/b]

This is a tough one, I really love the extreme areas. Doing huge tricks off every dangerous cliff is very satisfying! But if I had to pick one I would go with a challenge called "Mount Blanc Red Bull Linecatcher", it's very challenging.

[b]Proudest achievement?[/b]

My proudest achievement in Steep has to be winning a snowboard in the Sammy Luebke Challenge! (Without Flat Ground Mini-Tricks too)

[b]What you do besides playing Steep?[/b]

When I am not playing Steep I am mostly trying to create entertaining videos on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/Mstifye]Youtube Channel[/url]! Other than that I also enjoy graphic designing, listening to music, and of course playing video games!

[b]Your wildest dream about Steep?[/b]

Believe it or not, Steep has offered things I've dreamed about doing in videogames forever! For example, the Sammy Luebke Snowboard Challenge, I've always wanted to compete to win real life items, and The Steep World Tour Series, a tournament right inside the game that players could participate in. So far, Steep has exceeded my expectations! But I guess my wildest dream that I would like to see in the game is some sort of team battles where multiple riders could work together to set scores and face other individuals.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/8ae7123774888abb1b3e31063266c4f16cbe1aeb.jpg[/img]

[b]What's your primary playstyle?[/b]

Extreme rider for sure. I like putting my rider into situations no sane human would ever find themselves in. It's nice to just hit restart after the abusive 1000ft drops I constantly put him through.

[b]What's your favorite sport to play in Steep?[/b]

Without a doubt snowboarding! Let those 2 plankers and squirrels have their fun but everybody knows snowboarders do it best.

[b]Favorite spot?[/b]

That's tough, so many. Right now, I like riding around La Fieuse seeing if I can get through the wingsuit gaps on a board (most times it doesn't end well). I'm sure there will be new spots I haven't found yet and that's definitely one of Steeps' strong points.

[b]Proudest Achievement?[/b]

Well, I do a little happy dance whenever I manage an All-Time! But I'd say overall I'm probably most proud of our short film "Last Chair". Took a lot of people's efforts to try and bring my vision of storytelling inside Steep to life. There are sooo many creative people out there making really great films using Steep (most notable for me are "Blueprint" and "Welcome"). I was just hoping to follow along with these guys and make something worthwhile. But that's for the community to decide and overall I've been really happy with the feedback from everyone. So a big thank you!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o0Gv1qhpsw0
[b]What do you do besides play Steep?[/b]

Snowboard and work. Nothing is better than being out on a mountain with friends, just flying down runs and playing in the woods. Those are my favorite days. But bills need to be paid (as my wife likes to remind me every time I pick up the controller) so I have my own business where I do contracting work. It's nice to be able to craft things from scratch.

[b]Your wildest dream about Steep?[/b]

I just want it to last and always hold my interest. Which so far it has done marvelously. I would like to see something resembling a live jam session event added. Think big air at xgames. Players grouped up, competing live against each other for a set time to see who can do the best trick/jump. Could be kind of cool to interact with everybody online at a particular time but hey, everybody wants something right. Just keep the good stuff coming Ubisoft!

notes.title: Steep Star #7: Tergo0
notes.content:
[img]https://ubistatic19-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/Steep_Star_7_Tergo0_web-news_286648.jpg[/img]

[b]What name do you go by?[/b]

Tergo0 on Steep, as you can tell, Tergo was already taken. On YouTube my user name is Kalli.

[b]What’s your primary Playstyle?[/b]

Freestyle for sure. I enjoy doing all kinds of tricks on my snowboard and ski, which frankly really boils down to only two or three tricks. I tend to point my sticks in the same directions over and over again just to keep myself from falling :D

[img]https://ubistatic19-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/steepiv_286632.jpg[/img]

[b]Your favorite sport to play in Steep?[/b]

I really love the wingsuit and especially the proximity flying challenges. There is just something magical about being 5 inches above the ground and have that 'KO' sign slammed in my face everytime I try to get even closer to incoming rocks or trees. When my character hits a boulder or a power pole, I keep playing 'Don't Dream It's Over' by Crowded House in my head.

[b]Favorite spot?[/b]

Probably the new village location in Alaska, it really gives you more options to do cool tricks and it has some amazing grinding spots. Although I really wonder how all residents would react if they were able to see me grinding their cars and roofs 16 times a day.

[b]Proudest achievement?[/b]

The best achievements in Steep are pretty much always connected to failing and failing and failing and eventually winning the challenge you tried to beat for the previous 8 hours. Like La Fieuse, which took me nearly hundreds of attempts to even get through its first few moments. Don't even get me started on getting the Gold medal on those kind of challenges... If I manage to go through them without a scratch and only win the Silver medal, that's okay, right? Right?

[b]What you do besides playing Steep?[/b]

I'm currently studying hard, or better, I'm hardly studying when you look at my current Steep playtime. Nonetheless, my studies do take up a lot of time right now and besides that I love playing guitar, hanging out with friends and getting lectured on my poor Steep skills [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/KalliEntertainment]on YouTube[/url].

[b]Your wildest dream about Steep?[/b]

I'm really excited to see the upcoming stuff that is supposed to come with the Season Pass. I love what Ubisoft Annecy has done with Steep since its release. The free Alaska Map alone is a sign that there are good guys behind this, they care about their community. My wildest dream about Steep is that the game can sell well enough that there will eventually be a sequel. I'm not quite sure what needs to be improved, but a new region alone will be enough to keep me playing.

notes.title: STATE OF THE GAME: Alaska!
notes.content:
[img]https://ubistatic19-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/Steep_TU5-Alaska_StateoftheGame_v02_283104.jpg[/img]

Dear Steep Players,

We’re proud to present our big, awesome (and free!) game update that includes a completely new mountain range, Alaska’s Mount Denali! Of course, like with any major update, we’re also bringing you new features and improvements to make your Steep experience even better.

Your feedback is extremely important to us, so please keep sending your comments our way!

[h1]ALASKAN MOUNTAINS – New![/h1]

The wonders of Alaska’s Mount Denali await! Travel from the Alps to the other side of the world where you’ll experience an array of environments, from glistening seas and plunging cliffs to lumberyards and seaside towns.

You’ll find a selection of Alaska highlights in the map below.

[img]https://ubistatic19-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/Steep_Alaska_Update_Map_SotG-TU5_283105.jpg[/img]

With as many kilometers/miles to explore and ride as the Alps, the Steep Alaska update includes 21 new [b]Challenges[/b], 2 [b]Invitationals[/b] and 1 [b]Mountain Story[/b] that immerses you in the lore of the highest peak in North America, Mount Denali.

[img]https://ubistatic19-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/Steep_Alaska_world-screen_SotG_283106.jpg[/img]

Finally, with the arrival of this Alaska update and all the new challenges it brings, the game’s [b]Level Cap[/b] has been raised from 25 to 30.

[h1]CHALLENGES: BRANDED & COMMUNITY – New![/h1]

Branded Challenges give players the chance to take on a trail challenge sponsored by our partner brands, enhancing the “real-life” authenticity of the Steep experience.

[img]https://ubistatic19-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/Steep_Branded-Challenge_TNF-Rising-Sun_283107.jpg[/img]

We’ve also made some important updates to our [url=http://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-GB/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:154-277525-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]Community Challenges[/url]. From now on, players earn XP when playing a Community Challenge and the ghost of the leaderboard’s top player will be displayed so that you can learn from the best.

You can visit our [url=https://support.ubi.com/en-GB/faqs/000025710/How-do-I-create-replay-and-share-challenges-with-others]Creating Challenges FAQ[/url] for a step-by-step guide on how to create, replay and share challenges with other players.

[h1]MORE ALASKA UPDATE DETAILS![/h1]

We hope you’ll enjoy this brand-new Alaska mountain adventure as much as we enjoyed designing and building it! Let’s hear from a couple members of the development team as they talk about what Alaska has in store for players in this [b]Steep Game Update #2[/b] video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VYQUf3sklmg
You can find the full [url=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1568811]Steep Game Update 1.05: Alaska Patch Notes[/url] in the forums.

Thanks for playing Steep and see you on the mountain!

- The Steep Team

notes.title: Patch notes - Alaska Game Update
notes.content:
Dear Steep Riders,

The hot topic this time is, of course, the addition of the Alaska mountain playground, including lots of improvements and fixes to get excited about! This update will be implemented during [url=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1586657]today's maintenance[/url].

As always, please let us know what you think because your feedback really does matter to us – Thanks!

[B][h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1][/B]
[LIST]
[*]ALASKA: a brand-new mountain playground! – In addition to the Alps, you can now ride on the steeper mountains of Alaska! This new world includes 21 additional challenges, 2 Invitational Challenges, and a Mountain Story. Oh, and the cool thing? The Alaska massif is as big as the Alps and it’s an entirely FREE update for Steep players!
[*]Level Cap Increase – This one should please achievers and competitive players. With Alaska and new challenges coming your way, we’ve raised the level cap from 25 to 30.
[*]New Customization Items – In order to give you a more authentic feeling of riding in Alaska, we’ve added a bunch of new “American-inspired” items to the Store! More will be coming soon over the next few weeks.
[*]Branded Challenges – These additional challenges are now displayed on the Live Page! Check out now The North Face Challenge we’ve just added, and keep your eyes open for new Branded Challenges coming every 2 weeks.
[*]Community Challenge Rewards – Now, every time you beat a Community Challenge you’ll be rewarded with XP.  
[*]Community Challenge Ghosts – Each Community Challenge now features the ghost of the player currently at the top of that challenge’s leaderboard.
[*][PC] Additional trail added in Alaska for the Benchmark. Now players can activate benchmark with different trails and test their PC for each massif. Trails are selected automatically based on the active massif.
[/LIST]

[B][h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Player Display Fade-out – There’s no longer a “pop in/out” effect when the player display appears/disappears.
[*]Player Display Border was added for better visibility.
[*]Improved Camera Behavior in tight areas (for example, rivers and canyons) and steep inclines.
[*]Completion UI Now on Progression Page
[*][PC] Updated preview images for the shadow quality option.
[/LIST]


[B][h1]BUGS FIXED[/h1][/B]
[LIST]
[*]A few players get stuck in the onboarding after the Rooftops challenge.
[*]Some players’ progress gets blocked during the onboarding phase.
[*]In certain instances, there is an additional replica of the character in coop replay.
[*]The "Steep World Tour" logo is sometimes missing from the pop-up while in fixed view.
[*]Not able to watch medal replays in public challenges.
[*]Players’ final rankings are not displayed on the Live Page after the SWT Finals phase has ended.
[*]"My Shared Dare" is included in the Welcome Dashboard featured activities.
[*]Players receive no notification when they earn Steep Credits.
[*]Players receive no notification when they win Steep Credits during the Tournament phase of the Steep World Tour.
[*]When player is looking up at the sky in Free cam mode and then switch to Look-at mode. Camera stays focused on the sky.
[*]The Follow Camera seems to run behind when using Slow Motion.
[*]The camera is in the wrong position after spawning for the first time on an Invitational Challenge.
[*]Characters in coop replay will disappear if the player rewinds the replay video from the middle back to start and switches the camera to another character.
[*]The audio of Gold countdown still plays even if the challenge is completed.
[*]When ending a coop replay, the camera stops following the group member it was focused on.
[*]Subtitles continue to display even after player has skipped the end of the onboarding cinematic.
[*]Wrong camera behavior when the player opens the menu during the onboarding.
[*]HUD element “Unmark Drop Zone” continues to display if the player closes his binoculars while still being locked on to a Drop Zone.
[*]Creating a challenge on the last point of a trail breaks the trail interaction flow.
[*]The Santa Claus costume doesn't trigger its special taunt sound, “Ho, ho, ho!”
[*]In the last two phases of the Tournament, the notification showing the number of tries left contains a curly bracket in Portuguese.
[*]Saved trails are lost when rebooting the game.
[*][PC] Group disbands when one of the party members starts downloading a challenge and leaves the group.
[*][PC] Wrong position of UI elements when a player starts another player's dare.
[*][PC] Wrong position of the Today's Suggestions on the Welcome Dashboard.
[*][PC] Several localization issues.
[*][PC] Character's shadow flickers on Low and Medium quality.
[*][PC] Flickering of shadows from the rocks.
[*][PC] Wrong position of the ghost markers when riding in GOPRO mode.
[*][PC] Wrong resolution autodetects when default monitor changes from 21:9 to 16:9 using multimonitor configuration.
[*][PC] "GPU usage" does not display in the Benchmark report when AMD crossfire is turned off.
[/LIST]

notes.content:
Dear Steep Riders,

The hot topic this time is, of course, the addition of the Alaska mountain playground, including lots of improvements and fixes to get excited about! This update will be implemented during [url=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1586657]today's maintenance[/url].

As always, please let us know what you think because your feedback really does matter to us – Thanks!

[B][h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1][/B]
[LIST]
[*]ALASKA: a brand-new mountain playground! – In addition to the Alps, you can now ride on the steeper mountains of Alaska! This new world includes 21 additional challenges, 2 Invitational Challenges, and a Mountain Story. Oh, and the cool thing? The Alaska massif is as big as the Alps and it’s an entirely FREE update for Steep players!
[*]Level Cap Increase – This one should please achievers and competitive players. With Alaska and new challenges coming your way, we’ve raised the level cap from 25 to 30.
[*]New Customization Items – In order to give you a more authentic feeling of riding in Alaska, we’ve added a bunch of new “American-inspired” items to the Store! More will be coming soon over the next few weeks.
[*]Branded Challenges – These additional challenges are now displayed on the Live Page! Check out now The North Face Challenge we’ve just added, and keep your eyes open for new Branded Challenges coming every 2 weeks.
[*]Community Challenge Rewards – Now, every time you beat a Community Challenge you’ll be rewarded with XP.  
[*]Community Challenge Ghosts – Each Community Challenge now features the ghost of the player currently at the top of that challenge’s leaderboard.
[*][PC] Additional trail added in Alaska for the Benchmark. Now players can activate benchmark with different trails and test their PC for each massif. Trails are selected automatically based on the active massif.
[/LIST]

[B][h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1][/B]
[LIST]
[*]Player Display Fade-out – There’s no longer a “pop in/out” effect when the player display appears/disappears.
[*]Player Display Border was added for better visibility.
[*]Improved Camera Behavior in tight areas (for example, rivers and canyons) and steep inclines.
[*]Completion UI Now on Progression Page
[*][PC] Updated preview images for the shadow quality option.
[/LIST]


[B][h1]BUGS FIXED[/h1][/B]
[LIST]
[*]A few players get stuck in the onboarding after the Rooftops challenge.
[*]Some players’ progress gets blocked during the onboarding phase.
[*]In certain instances, there is an additional replica of the character in coop replay.
[*]The "Steep World Tour" logo is sometimes missing from the pop-up while in fixed view.
[*]Not able to watch medal replays in public challenges.
[*]Players’ final rankings are not displayed on the Live Page after the SWT Finals phase has ended.
[*]"My Shared Dare" is included in the Welcome Dashboard featured activities.
[*]Players receive no notification when they earn Steep Credits.
[*]Players receive no notification when they win Steep Credits during the Tournament phase of the Steep World Tour.
[*]When player is looking up at the sky in Free cam mode and then switch to Look-at mode. Camera stays focused on the sky.
[*]The Follow Camera seems to run behind when using Slow Motion.
[*]The camera is in the wrong position after spawning for the first time on an Invitational Challenge.
[*]Characters in coop replay will disappear if the player rewinds the replay video from the middle back to start and switches the camera to another character.
[*]The audio of Gold countdown still plays even if the challenge is completed.
[*]When ending a coop replay, the camera stops following the group member it was focused on.
[*]Subtitles continue to display even after player has skipped the end of the onboarding cinematic.
[*]Wrong camera behavior when the player opens the menu during the onboarding.
[*]HUD element “Unmark Drop Zone” continues to display if the player closes his binoculars while still being locked on to a Drop Zone.
[*]Creating a challenge on the last point of a trail breaks the trail interaction flow.
[*]The Santa Claus costume doesn't trigger its special taunt sound, “Ho, ho, ho!”
[*]In the last two phases of the Tournament, the notification showing the number of tries left contains a curly bracket in Portuguese.
[*]Saved trails are lost when rebooting the game.
[*][PC] Group disbands when one of the party members starts downloading a challenge and leaves the group.
[*][PC] Wrong position of UI elements when a player starts another player's dare.
[*][PC] Wrong position of the Today's Suggestions on the Welcome Dashboard.
[*][PC] Several localization issues.
[*][PC] Character's shadow flickers on Low and Medium quality.
[*][PC] Flickering of shadows from the rocks.
[*][PC] Wrong position of the ghost markers when riding in GOPRO mode.
[*][PC] Wrong resolution autodetects when default monitor changes from 21:9 to 16:9 using multimonitor configuration.
[*][PC] "GPU usage" does not display in the Benchmark report when AMD crossfire is turned off.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Steep Star #6: MrHyy
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/188ab3b037ecf9e746acd553f051b7d7dc1ae2df.jpg[/img]

[b]What name do you go by?[/b]
MrHyy in Steep, MrHyyTV on YouTube and hyydarkstar on PSN.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/477645e2930677c2c2633d8a4ffa10678bd1d914.jpg[/img]

[b]What’s your primary Playstyle?[/b]
Pro Rider, because I love to improve my time and score in all challenges. That feeling when, after hours of tries, you finally beat a world record only by a few milliseconds is the best thing ever!

[b]Your favorite sport to play in Steep?[/b]
Skiing and snowboarding, but if I had to pick just one I would go with snowboarding.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/a30d0d116f5f65b688f5d223b9973c09f434b596.jpg[/img]

[b]Favorite spot?[/b]
I don't really have a favorite spot as I usually spend my time trying to find new lines and exploring the map, but I particularly like Pointe Blanche.

[b]Proudest achievement?[/b]
Creating a really difficult wingsuit Community Challenge (“Zigzaghorn”) on the Matterhorn. It seemed impossible at first, but I literally jumped from the chair when I managed to complete it!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YQDRUqek-1s
[b]What you do besides playing Steep?[/b]
I'm studying for my high school diploma and I spend my free time playing video games. I also love to create music with my MacBook. Oh, and I'm the guy behind [url=https://twitter.com/Steep_News]@Steep_News[/url] :)

[b]Your wildest dream about Steep?[/b]
Winning the Steep World Tour!
