notes.title: STATE OF THE GAME: Update 1.04
notes.content:
[img]https://ubistatic19-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-NORDIC/game/steep/game/Steep_TU4-StateoftheGame_20172701_282723.JPG[/img]

Dear Steep Players,

We’re excited to bring you an important update to Steep! Besides including more types of challenges and a monthly Steep World Tour tournament series, we’ve also added some new features and made improvements to existing ones.

Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please continue to let us know what you think about the game and how we can make it even better!

[h1]LIVE ACTIVITY PAGE – [u]New![/u][/h1]

Now when you start up the game, you’ll see in real-time all the new and popular activities going on! Get all the latest info on tournaments and challenges, including the Steep World Tour and Community Challenges, directly in Steep with the [b]Live Activity Page[/b].

[img]https://ubistatic19-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-NORDIC/game/steep/game/Steep_livepage_TU4_v02_282622.png[/img]

[b]STEEP WORLD TOUR: TOURNAMENT SERIES – [u]New![/u][/b]

It’s time to get in the competitive spirit! We’re excited to announce the start of the [b]Steep World Tour[/b], a monthly tournament series, coming in Game Update 1.04!

To learn more about the Steep World Tour, check out our [url=http://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-GB/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:154-282608-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]Steep World Tour infographic[/url] and video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fajgoEENijU
[h1]COMMUNITY & DEV CHALLENGES – [u]New![/u][/h1]

[b]Community Challenges[/b] are all about showing off you, the players! We’ll select the most amazing trail challenges created by players and make them available to the entire community to play and compete against each other. The dev team will also be making an appearance from time to time, so be on the lookout for [b]Dev Challenges[/b] so that you can go up against the Steep game designers themselves and try to beat their scores!

More information about Community Challenges can be found in this article: [url=http://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-GB/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:154-277525-16&ct=tcm:154-76770-32]Steep Community Challenges[/url]

Want to know more about how to create a trail challenge that you can share with your friends? Visit our [url=https://support.ubi.com/en-GB/faqs/000025710/How-do-I-create-replay-and-share-challenges-with-others]Creating Challenges FAQ[/url] for a step-by-step guide on how to create, replay and share challenges with other players.

This game update brings you these new challenges and more! Hear from the Steep team themselves as they talk about these new features available now in Steep:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g83RX1eS6U8
[h1]DIRECTOR MODE (REPLAY) – [u]New![/u][/h1]

A Steep Star is born! Now you can put those mad cinematography skills to good use with the new [b]Director Mode[/b] that allows players to choose from different camera angles (Free, Follow and Fixed Cam), as well as adjust the ambiance and time of day when capturing that epic moment.

[img]https://ubistatic19-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-AU/game/steep/game/Steep_StateoftheGame_Director-Mode_1_282620.jpg[/img]
[img]https://ubistatic19-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-AU/game/steep/game/Steep_StateoftheGame_Director-Mode_2_282621.jpg[/img]

[h1]OTHER FEATURE & SYSTEM IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

We’ve also made some changes and improvements to other existing features in Steep: improvements and tweaks have been made to [b]Mountain View[/b] navigation, [b]camera and HUD[/b]; a [b]G-force system[/b] with clearer feedback; adjustments to [b]jumping[/b] that make it more responsive; and finally some enhancements made to the [b]tricks system[/b].

We’ll let Arnaud Ragot, Game Director on Steep, and Thibaut Zimmer, Community Developer, tell you more about all the good stuff coming your way in our first [b]Gondola Lift Game Update 1.04[/b]!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P9btkI5VzE0
You can find the full [url=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1552412-Patch-notes-Game-Update-1-04]Steep Game Update 1.04 Patch Notes[/url] in the forums.

Thanks for playing Steep and see you on the mountain!

- The Steep Team

notes.title: Patch notes - Game Update 1.04
notes.content:
Dear Steep Riders,

We’ve been working hard to improve your game experience! Here’s the full list of new features and bug fixes that are part of this [B]Steep Game Update 1.04[/B]. The patch will be available after our scheduled maintenance happening today from 11:00 AM to 11:30 AM CET (GMT+1) on PC. More information about the maintenance can be found [url=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1554152-PC-PS4-XB1-Scheduled-Maintenance-27-01-2017]here[/url].

Please give us your feedback about this update and new features, and we thank you for playing Steep!

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]

[LIST]
[*][B]Welcome Dashboard[/B] - Displays the most important in-game news and suggests content for players’ current game session.
[*][B]Live Page[/B] – Provides more info on the Steep World Tour and current series going on, as well as which Community Challenges are available to play.
[*][B]Steep World Tour[/B] – A recurring competitive tournament open to all Steep players. Check out the Live Page for more details, including tournament phase and ranking information.
[*][B]Community Challenges[/B] – Challenges made by the Community, for the Community! Selected trail challenges created by the community will be highlighted and made available to all players as a Community Challenge to beat. Look for them in the new Live Page!
[*][B]New Customization Items[/B] – Shhh… they’re a surprise! More will be revealed in due time.
[*][B]Director Mode[/B] – Provides more freedom and Replay Mode options (such as camera types and ambiance) for players to get even more creative in their replay videos.
[*][B]Hide HUD[/B] – And last but not least (and because you asked for it!)… You now have the option to hide the HUD while riding or creating replay videos. You can toggle the HUD display by going into OPTIONS -> VIDEO.
[/LIST]


[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

[LIST]
[*][B]G-force System[/B]
We’ve improved the G-force system to make its function clearer and more accurate. Some riders expressed confusion concerning how/why they would fall while riding. The biggest hits will now activate the black-and-white dizziness state rather than triggering a fall, as was previously the case. The next hit, however, will trigger a fall.
[*][B]New Jump Behavior[/B]
The jumping system has been improved in order to make jumping more accurate. We noticed that certain complex logical sequences sometimes prevented players from being able to jump. This is no longer the case: when pressing the jump button, riders now actually jump!
[*][B]Character Barks[/B] are heard less often, as requested by the community.
[*][B]Mountain View Display[/B] has been improved. Now, only activities from the highlighted region appear, as requested by the community.
[*][B]Music Track[/B] no longer changes when retrying a challenge. Instead, the same track is played again, as requested by players.
[*][B]Display of Players’ Icons[/B] has been improved with increased visibility.
[*][B]Challenge Ghosts[/B] are now tracked more efficiently in order to better monitor challenges for potential cheating.
[/LIST]



[h1]BUGS FIXED[/h1]

[LIST]
[*]Players remain visible at more than 1000 meters.
[*]Some crashes occur.
[*]Players remain stuck on small hills while trying to ride forward.
[*]Riders spawn into a rock after teleporting to Butterfly Challenge.
[*]Memorable Moment "1st Daily", "1st Weekly", and "1st All Time" needed for 100% completion of the game.
[*]First snowboard push-off is stronger than skiing (not intended behavior). Fixed per community request.
[*]"NEW" message appears on several already completed Challenges, Mountain Stories, and Legendary Quests.
[*]The score displayed on the challenge panel is not the one from the ghost played.
[*]The subtitles of the 'Winter Wonderland' Mountain Story inaccurately refers to the “Atacma” desert instead of the correct “Atacama”.
[*]The Friends Leaderboard displays inconsistent ranking information when you have less than 3 friends.
[*]Info Panel score resets to its default setting when joining a group, even though the player has already completed the challenge.
[*]The character will remain in a standing position when the installation of the game is completed during a ride.
[*]A non-functioning "Medals" button appears on the challenge menu after sharing a private challenge.
[*]When playing a challenge with a logo, the next played private challenge will also display the logo.
[*]Mountain Story Barbegazi Ski Orienteering ("Find the BARBEGAZI") objective won't update on the Quest Info Panel if doing clue #2 before clue #1.
[*]Mountain Story LE GROS ROGNON DU GEANT can only be completed only after hitting the iceberg at the end of the race.
[*]Teleport to another player in the player's group does not work.
[*]The Memorable Moment "Score more than 1,000 Freeride points in one ride" does not trigger when the player reaches the required score. 
[*]When selecting a challenge or quest from the Progress Menu while the character is in fixed view, the player can see outside of the world.
[*]The message "You are close enough to unlock a Drop Zone" pops up after discovering a new Drop Zone. 
[*]The Objectives panel of two Mountain Stories continues to display in Mountain View even after completion (“Mountain Scraper” in Switzerland, “Bird of Prey” in Mont Blanc).
[*]For a few Mountain Stories, when the player selects it from the Progress Menu he/she is spawned on an incorrect challenge.
[*][XB1] Low fps in game while in a 4-person coop session.
[*][XB1] All challenges completed during onboarding will lose their scores after finishing the onboarding.
[*]Wrong rules are displayed for Snow Snake Challenge.
[*]Icons and panels flicker when the player moves the RS button on the menu after switching between "Rider Tab" or "Profile" and "Progress Menu".
[*]A second helmet is attached to the backpack when a wingsuit costume is equipped while the wingsuit helmet/ backpack sub-menus are selected.
[*]The sound becomes briefly corrupted when the user opens the Sports wheel or changes the camera.
[*]The "GoPro Be a HERO" writing on the paraglide starts flickering when the character swings.
[*]The "Black and Orange Snowboard Shoes" appear two times in the shop.
[*]Transporting to a challenge does not occur when selecting it from the "Progress Menu" if the menu was opened while the binoculars were equipped.
[*]The objective to "Create Challenge" in the onboarding can be validated if the user presses d-pad left and moves the cursor on a trail challenge.
[*]Slightly glitchy clouds at night during "Say Hi!" Challenge.
[*]The strong coop session icon appears for a user that's not in the party, under certain circumstances.
[*]The player will lose the ability to change or play any sport after manually entering ragdoll state inside the wicker basket of a hot air balloon.
[*][PC] Removed possibility to jump with LT/L2
[*][PC] Fixed narrator in the Benchmark.
[*][PC] Fixed several incorrect line breakers in text.
[*][PC] Fixed aliasing on the Steam Controller feedback icons and recolored them in black/white style like for all other icons.
[*][PC] Fixed accuracy of the head tracking using eye tracking.
[*][PC] Changed speed of "Zoom at gaze" using eye tracking.
[*][PC] Fixed disconnection of the "Extended View" feature after changing display mode using eye tracking.
[*][PC] Fixed several crashes.
[*]Minor display issues - Thanks for reading this far and see you on the mountain!
[/LIST]

notes.title: Steep Star #4: xGBx Boogie
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/73d0a9b9d223544d88776716ef5aab5d4f1659f7.jpg[/img]

[b]What name do you go by?[/b]						
In the forums and on Xbox, I go by xGBx Boogie.

[b]What’s your primary Playstyle?[/b]						
My primary playstyle would be Exploring. The world is so large, I have a lot of fun exploring, finding new lines to ride and new spots to spawn on. It seems like every time I load the game, I find great new lines to ride. When I find a line I really like, I save it so I can keep coming back later on.
					
[b]Your favorite sport to play in Steep?[/b]						
My favorite sport by far would be Skiing. I grew up learning to ski from a young age, growing up always playing all the snowboarding games from Cool Boarders on PS1 to the Apes series and Stoked series to get my winter fix. Now that there is a solid skiing game, I’ve fallen in love.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25889213/c31e314f7ffcca13046d3f4c154105ee527af655.jpg[/img]
				
[b]Favorite spot?[/b]						
My favorite spot to ride would be anywhere in the Cursed Mountains. The peaks over there provide so many possibilities. You have the rocky passes, steep chutes, and glacier runs. So many great lines that I don't get bored much on that part of the mountain.
					
[b]Proudest achievement?[/b]						
To continue on with the exploring aspect, my proudest achievement would be finding all the Points of Interest. It was a long process, the last 10 seemed like they took forever, but by skiing different lines I finally unlocked them all.
					
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uIu6D51zoa0
[b]What you do besides playing Steep?[/b]						
I am an avid guitarist. I have been playing through Rocksmith and having a lot of fun learning to play some of my favorite songs. I also enjoy playing the Forza games and the Battlefield series.
					
[b]Your wildest dream about Steep?[/b]						
Steep has been a dream come true for me, as well as for all winter sports enthusiasts. With the added sports and Alaska coming later on, it will only get better. My wildest dream would be to allow us to build jumps wherever we like for even more fun, and add rails to the game with the ability to grind with snowboard or skis. If those were implemented, it would bring the game to a whole new level.

notes.title: Patch notes - Game Update 1.03
notes.content:
Hello and Happy New Year! To start off 2017 on the right foot, here is a list of new additions and bug fixes you’ll find in [B]Steep Game Update 1.03[/B]. More to come soon!

[h1][B]New Additions[/B][/h1] 

[B]Tricks Improvements [All Platforms][/B]
If you ever struggled to perform tricks on skis or snowboard, this should definitely make things easier for you!

From now on, you can pre-select your next rotation before releasing your jump. Just push the left stick forward toward a specific direction, release your jump and your rotation will instantly be triggered.

Also, you can now combine turns and rotations more smoothly. Try to trigger tricks as you turn or switch and you’ll really feel the difference!

If you still appreciate calculating timing and using additional stick inputs, don’t worry, nothing has changed for you.

We hope you’ll enjoy these tricks improvements and look forward to hearing your feedback soon!

[h1][B]PC only[/B][/h1]
[LIST]
[*]Added Ultra+ environment quality
[*]Added the notification when a gamepad is connected or disconnected
[*]Added Steam Controller feedback 
[/LIST]

[h1][B]Bug Fixes[/B][/h1]
Fixed: [PC, PS4 Pro] Ghosts stuttering at 60 FPS 
Fixed: [PC] Friends removed via Uplay are still visible in the contact list
Fixed: [PC] Framerate drop when using ragdoll in the wingsuit with equipped smoke flare
Fixed: [PC] Framerate drop in the customization menu
Fixed: [PC] Loss of functionality when unplugging and plugging in again a gamepad on Windows 7 and Windows 8.1
Fixed: [PC] Incorrect refresh rate order in the display options
Fixed: [PC] Crash when equipped with two video cards from different vendors
Fixed: [PC] Several crashes

Thanks for playing Steep and see you on the mountain!

notes.title: STATE OF THE GAME: Update 1.02
notes.content:
[img]https://ubistatic9-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/HEADER_Steep_TU2-Highlights_20162012_278907.jpg[/img]

Dear Steep Players,
					
Our latest game update is now live! You’ll find below highlights of fixes and improvements now available in Steep. We thank you for your feedback and keep it coming – we’re listening!
					
[list][*][b]Progression Page Added to Menu[/b]							
Players can now check their progression from the menu and have an overview of all the challenges they have completed, as well as the ones remaining to be completed or unlocked. Challenges can also be filtered by type or sport. You can select any unlocked challenge and be sent directly to it in Mountain View. It’s a new way to browse quickly through the content in the game.[/*][/list]
				[img]https://ubistatic9-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/Steep_New-Progress_Menu_TU2_278908.png[/img]

[list][*][b]Fixed: Tricks Exploit[/b]							
A system now informs players when they don’t move on to the next checkpoint after a pre-set amount of time, preventing them from being able to go back up the mountain to score tricks. Players attempting to boost snowboard/skiing challenge scores in this way will now be automatically detected and disqualified when trying to complete these challenges.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]Fixed: “Help me, I’m Stuck on a Rock and I can’t get up!”[/b]							
Players no longer get stuck on rocks when retrying a challenge.[/*]											[*][b]Fixed: “Customization Reset”[/b]							
A character’s customization is no longer reset to default after a player has previously mixed various pieces of costumes and items.[/*]											[*][b]Fixed: “NEW Indicator, or the ‘Wait, didn’t I already do that challenge?’ Issue”[/b]							
Players who have already completed Invitational Challenges no longer see them marked as “NEW” on Mountain view. Instead, this “NEW” sign is replaced by “Already completed”.[/*]
[*][b]Fixed: “Permanent Players”[/b]							
Players no longer see other players who have left the map and/or aren’t riding next to them anymore.[/*]
[*][b]Fixed: “Connect to a Group”[/b]							
For Xbox One players who had issues joining other players for grouping, they should no longer receive an error message when attempting to do so.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]Miscellaneous Improvements:[/b]							
• When you ride, very distant challenges won’t be visible anymore, reducing the crowded feeling on screen and enhancing the immersion in the mountains.
• You can now change ambiance in Mountain View, using DPAD Down.
• In the RIDER page, you can now preview items before buying them. Leave your cursor on an item for a second and your rider’s preview will be updated
• You can now teleport to a player of your group directly from the Mountain View by selecting him/her with the cursor.[/*]					[/list]	
We hope these fixes and improvements enhance your experience in Steep, so please get back on that mountain and check them out!
					
- The Steep Team

notes.title: Steep Player Spotlight #2: Vanessa Magick
notes.content:
[img]https://ubistatic9-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/Steep_Player-Spotlight_2_VanessaMagick_web_279101.jpg[/img]

[b]What name do you go by?[/b]
    
Vanessa Magick in Steep and pretty much everywhere else. If you see me on the mountain, feel free to say Hi, or squeak at me, or do a front flip over my head, whichever you like!
     
[b]What’s your primary playstyle?[/b]

Explorer. I’m most well-known for walking across the entire Alps in Steep, from one corner to the other, in a grueling 4.5 hour trek. I loved it! Just seeing the sights, taking in the view… it’s better than any big jump on a snowboard or close call in a wingsuit.

[b]Your favorite sport to play in Steep?[/b]
     
Hiking! Good old-fashioned boots on the ground, the second oldest way to get down a mountain after falling. Hey, walking’s a sport, right? This might be a bit of an unorthodox answer, but I just like the sound of my feet crunching on the snow. Second place, though, would have to be snowboarding. Wind in my fur, sun trickling through my (unicorn) mane… it’s exhilarating!
     
[b]Favorite spot?[/b]
     
I’ve been everywhere. My favorite place is the last place I walked through, and it’s always been that way for me. However, the places I keep coming back to are the broken bobsleigh tracks around the Cursed Mountains. It’s a lot of fun to ride down them, and I can usually get some good views there – I might even have to try it in a sled some time!
     
[b]Proudest achievement?[/b]
     
I’ve gotten my fair share of world records, and I was one of the first to hit 100% challenge completion in the Alps. As for that 4.5 hour walk I did? Now, that’s something to brag about! People are usually pretty impressed by it, I think, and I can’t wait to do it again in Alaska!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-TG_ooEj8lw
     
[b]What you do besides playing Steep?[/b]
     
Since the game was released, I’ve honestly not been doing a whole lot else! I’m a musician, though. I’ve been playing piano for 15 years or so and I still tell people I’m learning it. Never a bad time to practice it and, for the record, I kick butt at Guitar Hero, too!
     
[b]Your wildest dream about Steep?[/b]
     
Steep was a game that surprised me more than anyone. I’d never really been into sports games (especially not extreme sports games), so I can’t say I was super hyped about Steep until I played it with a streamer friend, BattleAthlete, and it blew my mind! In that sense, it’s already beyond my wildest dreams, but I hope that Steep gets even bigger than it already is – in every sense of the word: more content, more players, and more square feet to walk through. Perhaps one day I’ll be able to get my name etched into a tree in one of the corners of the map… Cuz this unicorn’s legs aren’t getting tired any time soon!

notes.title: Open Beta Dev Challenge Contest: The Winners!
notes.content:
[img]https://previewsites.ubisoft.com/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/Header-player-feedback_277894.jpg[/img]

During the Steep Open Beta, we challenged you to beat the scores of 4 devs on their Trail Challenges. Many of you took on these challenges, but only the following riders managed to finish at the top of the leaderboards at the end of Open Beta. These riders are (drum roll…):
					
[b]PlayStation 4[/b]
					[list]						[*]VNC_Yklo (France): Mitch’s Paraglide Challenge[/*]						[*]mickapouel (Canada): Matthias’ Wingsuit Challenge[/*]						[*]tommeuh (France): Spoox’s Ski challenge[/*]					[/list]					
[b]Xbox One[/b]
					[list]						[*]Hittinofr (USA): Mitch’s Paraglide Challenge[/*]						[*]Itarop (USA): Matthias’ Wingsuit Challenge[/*]						[*]Ayojuan15 (USA): Spoox’s Ski challenge[/*]					[/list]					
[b]PC[/b]
					[list]						[*]eob (USA): Matthias’ Wingsuit Challenge[/*]					[/list]					
Congrats to the winners – we’ll soon get in touch with you for sending out your snowboard!
					
Unfortunately, we had to disqualify some players due to them being from an ineligible country* or because of the use of an exploit in the tricks system which artificially boosted scores. The tricks exploit issue has been fixed and will be deployed in game update 1.02. We thank you for your understanding and hope that you’ll support us in making competition in Steep as fair as possible.
					
Thanks to all of you who participated and stay tuned for our next contest!
					
[u]*Open Beta Dev Challenge Contest Eligible Countries: France, Spain, United Kingdom, Germany, Russia, USA, Canada, Brazil, Switzerland, Netherlands, Australia and New Zealand. Full [url=http://ubistatic2-a.akamaihd.net/gamesites/steep/Steep-Dev_Challenge-ENG-Nov16-JBM.docx]Contest Rules[/url].[/u]

notes.title: Made in the Alps #1-3: World, Tricks, Sharing
notes.content:
[img]https://ubistatic9-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/HEADER-Steep_Made-in-the-Alps_278465.jpg[/img]

Our “Made in the Alps” video series takes you to Annecy, France to hear from the Steep team about designing and developing the game.
 
[b]Made in the Alps #1: The World[/b]
     
You can’t have a massive open-world mountain without, well, designing the world… In the first episode, the team talks about being inspired by having the Alps right at their front door to create a breath-taking environment and exciting experience on the mountain.
     
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fvKBkqQN3yQ
     
[b]Made in the Alps #2: Tricks[/b]
     
In this episode, we take you back to the Alps to talk to the Freestyler contingent of the Ubisoft Annecy team about designing the tricks system in Steep and how you can become the ultimate Freestyler!
     
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jbJrXAaEFaU
     
[b]Made in the Alps #3: Sharing[/b]
     
Want to relive or share with friends that epic moment on the mountains? In this third installment of the series, the dev team talks about the challenge creation and video sharing features in Steep. To learn more about sharing (and a lot more!), check out our [url=http://ubi.li/xftb5]Tips for Playing Steep[/url] in the forums.
     
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d4DOE0UCkho
     
[b]Show us what you got![/b]
     
This is your time to shine on the mountain – show the Steep Community your most epic moments and amazing rides! Use #SteepGame and #SteepCommunity when sharing your videos or screenshots, or you can send them directly to us at SteepCreators@ubisoft.com.
     
While you’re checking out these first videos in our Made in the Alps series, why not head over to our [url=http://ubi.li/vr9x7]Steep Epic Rides Community Playlist[/url] on YouTube to see all the amazing stuff your fellow Steep players are creating?
     
See you on the mountain!

notes.title: Wot I Think: Steep
notes.content:
Steep [official site] is a lot like the extreme sportspeople it represents. It is excitable, loud and eager to have fun, fast and fresh. But in its haste and keenness it has somehow forgotten to take some of the most obvious precautions and frequently falls down flat on its face. The disappointing thing is that these failings mostly failings of control and flow – haven t just hobbled the game, they hobble the player too.
… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: STEEP PLAYER SPOTLIGHT #1: Fruitarian
notes.content:
[img]https://ubistatic9-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/HEADER-Steep_Player-Spotlight_Rectangle_277911.jpg[/img]

      [b]What name do you go by?[/b]      
Fruitarian in Steep, SoonHot on YouTube
     
[b]What’s your primary playstyle?[/b]      
Freerider
     
[b]Your favorite sport to play in Steep?[/b]      
Skiing
     
[b]Favorite spot?[/b]      
From the part of the world we were able to play during the Open Beta… [url=]it would have to be La Seche[/url] (which I think in French translates to ‘The Dry’, so someone French will have to explain that to me). It’s not one of the big popular Drop Zones, but I find myself going back there all the time. Why? La Seche couldn’t be more fittingly named – it's my go-to for a sesh! Every day is another of Steep’s ‘perfect days’ up there. It can be your launchpad for long winding rides down to the sparkling Lake Annecy, but me, I love it for being bright, wide, and inviting - perfect for inventing some fresh lines.
     
[b]Proudest achievement?[/b]      
Well as a Freerider, I’m happy just happening across new places, so discovering all the Points of Interest was a wonderfully chill way to play. I really enjoy making Freeride challenges for friends, too... and then watching them panic when they can’t trick or race to victory – this is about STYLE now compadres! Show me how smooth you can be!
     
[b]What you do besides playing Steep?[/b]      
I’m an Extreme Skier. Oh, besides Steep… well, I’m a pretty extreme poet? Whether in Steep or not, I know how to handle my Gs. ;)
     
[b]Your wildest dream about Steep?[/b]      
I see this game growing into a thriving online open-mountain community of players from all over the world making their own fun. Steep has a shot at being a landmark in this genre, and to achieve it I hope the talented Ubisoft Annecy Team can keep it alive with new content, expanding worlds, and more and more wild ways to bring players together in this extraordinary social playground. See you on the mountains everybody!

notes.title: We’ve Heard Your Feedback!
notes.content:
[img]https://ubistatic9-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/Header-player-feedback_277894.jpg[/img]

From the Steep Closed Alpha to the Open Beta, we’ve received tons of comments and feedback from players and we really appreciate it!
					
We strongly value players’ feedback and maintaining Steep as a community-driven game is a central part of the team’s DNA. So, here are some of the things you’ve been asking for and what we did to improve the Steep experience for you.
			
[b]You asked for: Improved Paragliding Experience[/b]							
[list][*]In a nutshell: You wanted paragliding to be more exciting and the controls to be more responsive.
[*]What we changed: We worked hard to improve the paraglide controls and camera in order to enhance the full experience and add some more thrill to the feeling of flying. We increased the responsiveness of the inputs and reduced inertia in order to bring you more thrilling moments as you slalom through forests and canyons.[/list]

[b]You asked for: More Replay/Capturing Options[/b]							
[list][*]In a nutshell: You wanted to be able to turn the HUD on/off when capturing a screenshot or video.
[*]What we changed: Brush up on your cinematic skills! You now have the option to remove the HUD when replaying your ride. Press TOUCHPAD/VIEW BUTTON/F11 to hide the HUD.[/list]

[b]You asked for: Iconic Tricks[/b]							
[list][*]In a nutshell: You’d like to be able to perform iconic tricks, like a Cork, a Rodeo, a Japan…
[*]What we changed: If freestyling’s your thing, you can now perform these iconic tricks in Steep! Tricks will now be labeled and displayed on screen every time you do one. Take a look at our “behind the scenes” video, [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jbJrXAaEFaU]Made in the Alps #2[/url], about designing the tricks system, as well as our video tutorials (for [url=http://youtu.be/FMfPBliBF5w]console[/url] or [url=http://youtu.be/PFzamVaKvIk]PC[/url]) to learn more about how to perform amazing tricks![/list]

[b]You asked for: More Sports/Activities[/b]							
[list][*]In a nutshell: Snowmobiles and sledding would make for some fun additions to the game.
[*]What we changed: While snowmobiles are not currently on the horizon, sledding, rocket wingsuit, base jumping and speed riding are all on their way! You can find out more about these “coming soon” additions to Steep (DLC content) in our [url=http://youtu.be/SL3uYXOdlbg]Season Pass Trailer[/url]![/list]
				
Oh, and pssst… The [b]free camera[/b] option you’ve been asking for? It’s already in the game! You can trigger the exploration camera by holding the L1/LB button and then using the right stick to control it.
					
Again, thank you for all the feedback we received and we hope that you like the changes you see! Please continue to share your comments and your suggestions with us on the [url=http://forums.ubi.com/forumdisplay.php/1251-Steep]forums[/url], [url=http://www.facebook.com/SteepGame/]Facebook[/url] and [url=http://twitter.com/Steep_Game]Twitter[/url] (@Steep_Game, #SteepGame) – we’re listening!

notes.title: Steep Community Challenges
notes.content:
[img]https://ubistatic9-a.akamaihd.net/resource/en-GB/game/steep/game/steep_news-community-challenges-header_277647.jpg[/img]

“Every ride, every trail you create / Every move you make…” in Steep can be turned into a Challenge and get pushed as a “dare” to your friends.
     
Starting in January, a Challenge you yourself create may just end up becoming a Community Challenge, meaning that it will become available to play by the entire PS4, Xbox One or PC community of players in Steep! This will surely bring you much fame and fortune! (well, we can’t really guarantee the fortune part…)
     
We’ll be keeping our eyes open for the best and most spectacular Challenges pushed by the players to their friends and then transform these into Community Challenges for each of the 4 sports in Steep. These 4 Community Challenges will be displayed in-game on the mountain, and their creators will receive a special reward!
     
So, get in the game and keep making and sharing those Challenges so that you, too, can become the Steep rider everyone wants to beat! Be sure to share your Challenges, videos and other creations with the community (#SteepCommunity, #SteepGame, SteepCreators@ubisoft.com) and show us what you’re up to in Steep, because fame is just around the corner…

notes.title: Welcome to the Mountains of Steep!
notes.content:
The open-world mountains of Steep are now all yours, so drop in and create your ride! Whether snowboarding, skiing, wingsuiting or paragliding, there are a variety of ways to experience Steep! Build your own expertise and go all-in with your favorite Playstyle.					
					
[b]PLAYSTYLES[/b]

[IMG]https://ubistatic9-a.akamaihd.net/resource/it-IT/game/steep/game/ob-guide-playstyles_275461.jpg[/IMG]	
				
You can learn more about the different Playstyles here: [url=http://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-gb/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:154-271375-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]Explorer[/url], [url=http://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-gb/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:154-273775-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]Bone Collector[/url], [url=http://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-gb/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:154-273399-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]Freerider[/url], [url=http://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-gb/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:154-273901-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]Extreme Rider[/url], [url=http://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-gb/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:154-273153-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]Freestyler[/url] and [url=http://steep.ubisoft.com/game/en-gb/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:154-274102-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]Pro Rider[/url].					
					
[b]WHERE WILL YOU RIDE?[/b]
					
Some spots you’ll be able to unlock as you progress, while others you’ll need to find… Be sure to scout uncharted areas and use your trusty binoculars to locate and unlock new Drop Zones and Challenges!

[IMG]https://ubistatic9-a.akamaihd.net/resource/it-IT/game/steep/game/Steep_news-explore-mtn-body2_271378.jpg[/IMG]
						
[b]TIPS & TRICKS[/b]
					
To get you riding down the mountain in no time, you’ll find a wealth of information and tips, as well as [url=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1525946-Tips-for-playing-Steep]detailed help on tricks[/url], all available in our Steep forums.					
					
[b]STEEP OFFICIAL TRICKS 101 TUTORIAL (Console/PS4)[/b]
					
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FMfPBliBF5w
					
[b]STEEP OFFICIAL TRICKS 101 TUTORIAL (PC)[/b]
					
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFzamVaKvIk
					
[b]SHOW US WHAT YOU GOT![/b]
					
This is your time to shine on the mountain – show the Steep Community your most epic moments and amazing rides! Use the sharing features on your console or PC in order to broadcast your gameplay or upload your videos to your preferred platform. You’ll find detailed information about sharing in our [url=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1525946-Tips-for-playing-Steep]Steep Tips forum post[/url].					
					
Be sure to use the hashtags #SteepGame #SteepCommunity and your Ubisoft username so that the community can find them easily, or you can send your creations directly to us at SteepCreators@ubisoft.com					
					
[b]STEEP COMMUNITY PLAYLIST[/b]
					
Create your ride, get famous! We’ve got our eye on Steep videos tagged with #SteepCommunity! So, if you video’s truly epic, we’ll share it on [url=http://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBnrd5k2F2IMZ-auzON_oJC76m42MP4_t]Steep Epic Rides[/url], our official Steep Community Playlist on YouTube.					
					
Please DO share your proudest achievements, memorable rides, amazing tricks, favorite spots or biggest fails with us on YouTube and we’ll make you a star!					
					
Follow us on Facebook ([url=http://www.facebook.com/steepgame/]/SteepGame[/url]), Twitter ([url=http://twitter.com/Steep_Game]@Steep_Game[/url], #SteepGame) and YouTube (Steep Community Playlist) for the latest news and to see the greatest creations from the Steep Community. See you on the mountain!

notes.title: Steep open beta: Great mountains, infuriating controls
notes.content:
The world has been in want of a good snowboarding game for a while. Having spent a few hours with the beta of Steep [official site] over the weekend, I m not yet sure that it is the successor to SSX and Cool Boarders that we’re looking for. But that s okay, because there are three other extreme sports rolled into it. And one of them involves donning a wingsuit and flying at hundreds of miles per hour towards your inevitable death.

notes.title: Snow joke: Steep now preloading for open beta weekend
notes.content: If you, like me, fancy hitting the slopes this weekend in the free open beta test for Ubisoft’s open-world xXtremewintersportsXx ’em up Steep [official site], fire up Uplay today. The beta doesn’t begin until Friday but you can now preload the game, which is handy as it’s a 19GB download. If that sounds big to you, hey, consider how big the Alps are. You could hardly take them home with you on the bus, could you? … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Steep Open Beta Weekend Hits The Piste In November
notes.content: Given that the PC version of Watch Dogs 2 is delayed, mid-November will be sorely lacking in Xtreme Livin’ It To The MaxX Kickin’ It Hangin’ Loose Dudes To The Max from Ubisoft. But wait, what’s that rumbling sound? Glory be! It’s an open beta weekend for Ubi’s xtreme wintersports ’em up Steep [official site], set to run November 18th to 21st. If you play the beta while listening to music from 2014 and shouting old Internet memes, Steep might just give you enough xtreme ‘tude to tide you over. … [visit site to read more]

notes.content:

notes.title: Pre-Purchase Now - Steep
notes.content:
Steep is Now Available for Pre-Purchase on Steam.

Ride a massive open world of the Alps and Alaska, where the powder is always fresh and the run never ends. Defy and master the world’s most epic mountains on skis, wingsuit, snowboard, and in paraglide. Go solo or drop in side by side with other players. Record and share the most insane stunts ever captured. Dare your friends to try out your custom lines, then challenge the world to beat your best tricks and relive your most epic wipeouts.

The mountain is yours to explore. So strap in, suit up, and drop in.
